description:
🚀 Join team AstroNoobs! 

I'm a full-stack MERN developer diving into our first NASA Space Apps Challenge. I bring a strong foundation in React, Node.js & building clean, responsive web applications.

We want to build a highly polished, interactive UI dashboard or simulation web game to maximize our winning potential. Looking for advanced, capable team mates-specifically UI/UX design masters, Python/data wizards or creative pitch storytellers. 

Let's build something epic!
